steps_h2: How to Use an Unboxing Video Maker in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Go from one clear product photo to a reveal you can post or test.

steps.d: Upload one clear photo with the whole item visible. The product in the open comes from this picture.
Say how the box opens, what the tissue does, and the order to show. Then pick a frame and a length, 6 to 30 seconds.
Download the clip when it is ready. Add captions, a price, or licensed music in your editor, then post it.

faq.q: What is an AI unboxing video?
faq.a: It is a short clip of a parcel opening onto your product, made from a photo of the item you sell. You describe the box and the order. No filming is required for the first cut.

faq.q: How do I make an unboxing video from a product photo?
faq.a: Upload a clear photo of the whole item, describe the open and the order shoppers should see, pick a frame and a length, then download the clip.

faq.q: Do I need a photo of the packaging?
faq.a: No. Start with a clear product photo and describe the box, mailer, or tissue you want in the scene.

faq.q: Can I show a bundle or the pieces inside?
faq.a: Yes. Name the main product and the included pieces, and show the main item before the extras.

faq.q: Which frames and lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4, and 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Use the frame the channel asks for.

faq.q: How many credits does an unboxing video use?
faq.a: A 6-second video uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60, and 30 seconds uses 120. The cost shows before you start, and a failed job gives the credits back.

faq.q: Can I use the clip in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. Finished clips can be used commercially and have no watermark. Add the offer in your editor and follow each platform's rules before you spend.

faq.q: Is the person opening the box a real customer?
faq.a: No. Any hands or presenter are generated for the ad, not a buyer. Do not present the clip as a customer review.

faq.q: Can I add captions, a price, or music after download?
faq.a: Yes. Add captions, your price, and licensed music in your own editor. This tool does not add them for you.

faq.q: Will words printed on the box come out right?
faq.a: Check every label on the download, and add final brand text in your editor. Lettering can vary.

faq.q: Will TikTok or Meta reject an AI unboxing ad?
faq.a: Do not present the clip as a customer review. Before you spend, read the current TikTok or Meta rule and add any label it asks for.
